regime_context: The policy regime is a sequenced, interest-aligned campaign: Fed (Warsh) banks hawkish credibility now to preserve optionality for easing later, while Treasury (Bessent) suppresses yields structurally via bill-heavy issuance. The consensus reads the hawkish tape as 'no cuts' — but revealed preference says the administration wants the OUTCOME of lower real yields without the OPTICS of near-term cuts, so a post-midterm pivot is pre-loaded, not priced.
regime_context_zh: 政策体制是一场按次序推进、利益对齐的行动：美联储（Warsh）现在积累鹰派信誉，为之后的宽松保留选择权；财政部（Bessent）则通过偏重短债的发行结构压低利率。市场共识把鹰派信号解读为“不降息”——但真实偏好显示：政府想要的是更低实际利率的结果，而不是近期降息的政治观感，因此中期选举后的转向已被预先铺垫，只是尚未被定价。

theses.subject: TLT
theses.thesis: Warsh's revealed preference is inflation-mandate first; with CME FedWatch pricing >70% probability of a September hike and real 10y at 2.29%, the front end stays tight and the long end carries hike risk into fall. Bessent's 'strong dollar while cutting' has not yet delivered the cut, so TLT faces duration pain before any pivot.
theses.thesis_zh: Warsh 的真实偏好是通胀目标优先；CME FedWatch 对 9 月加息的概率定价已超 70%，10 年期实际利率处于 2.29%，短端维持偏紧，长端在秋季仍承受加息风险。Bessent 的“强势美元同时降息”尚未兑现降息，因此在任何转向之前，TLT 面临久期压力。
evidence: Iran/Middle East theater: ceasefire collapsed 7/8, Brent spiked ~$80 intraday, stagflationary split sharpened
Open prediction: Fed does NOT cut at July and September 2026 meetings
Market state: Reflation quad, inflation_score 0.68, Fed path gap market ≈ Fed (3bp)
theses.dissent: If June payrolls' +57k crack widens, the labor leg of the stagflationary split could force a data-driven September pivot, which would rally duration sharply.
theses.dissent_zh: 若 6 月新增非农仅 +57k 的裂缝进一步扩大，滞胀分裂中的就业端可能迫使美联储做出数据驱动的 9 月转向，届时长久期资产将大幅反弹。

falsifier.text: TLT outperforms SPY by 8% before the check-by date on a September cut/hold-dovish shift
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日之前，TLT 因 9 月降息或鸽派按兵不动而跑赢 SPY 8%

theses.subject: XLE
theses.thesis: The Iran re-escalation is a realized upside oil shock, energy was the top ETF-inflow sector in Q1 2026, and the ceasefire collapse re-primes the rotation. The administration's FX bridge (strong dollar + haven bid) tolerates the oil tail because it validates the inflation narrative that pre-loads a post-midterm pivot.
theses.thesis_zh: 伊朗再度升级是一次已实现的上行石油冲击，能源板块是 2026 年一季度 ETF 资金流入最多的板块，而停火协议破裂重新点燃了资金轮动。政府的汇率桥梁（强势美元 + 避险买盘）能容忍石油尾部风险，因为它印证了通胀叙事，为中期选举后的转向预埋伏笔。
evidence: Iran/Middle East theater: Brent spiked ~$80 intraday 7/8, rotation real and re-primed
China theater: two-sided but upside-skewed on oil headlines
Recent track: XLE overweight low hit twice (7/25 and 8/1)
theses.dissent: A rapid Iran de-escalation or truce would unwind the geopolitical premium; energy is headline-fragile and can round-trip faster than the fundamentals.
theses.dissent_zh: 伊朗迅速降级或达成休战将解除地缘政治溢价；能源板块对消息面极度敏感，回撤速度可能快于基本面。

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 6% before the check-by date on Iran de-escalation headlines
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日之前，XLE 因伊朗局势降级消息而落后 SPY 6%

theses.subject: OKLO
theses.thesis: Nuclear-for-AI is a FACT mechanism of the re-industrialization campaign, and the DOE HALEU fuel-bank release is an open prediction that would directly de-risk private nuclear/AI projects. OKLO sits at the intersection of the power-grid-datacenter capex theme and the uranium/HALEU fuel cycle, with policy tailwinds distinct from the Fed path.
theses.thesis_zh: 核能-人工智能是再工业化行动中的既定机制，DOE 向燃料银行投放 HALEU 是一项公开预测，将直接降低私营核能/AI 项目的风险。OKLO 处于电网-数据中心资本开支主题与铀/HALEU 燃料循环的交汇点，其政策顺风独立于美联储路径。
evidence: Rotation targeted: Nuclear · uranium · HALEU/fuel cycle (proxies include OKLO)
Open prediction: DOE releases ≥20 MT HALEU into the fuel bank for private/AI projects
Power · grid · datacenter capex (AI compute) theme
theses.dissent: OKLO is an early-stage, high-multiple name; in a hike-majority regime with rising real rates, long-duration speculative assets get hit hardest before any pivot materializes.
theses.dissent_zh: OKLO 属于早期阶段、高估值品种；在加息概率占优、实际利率上行的环境中，长久期投机性资产在转向兑现前受到的冲击最大。

falsifier.text: OKLO lags SPY by 12% before the check-by date without a DOE HALEU release
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日之前，OKLO 在 DOE 未投放 HALEU 的情况下落后 SPY 12%

theses.subject: GLD
theses.thesis: Gold is trading $4,044–4,200 after a 2026 rally, but the hawkish Fed staging phase (hike-majority Sept odds, real 10y 2.29%, DXY off 13-month low) is a headwind for a zero-coupon asset when the Fed is credibility-banking inflation-fighting. The Mar-a-Lago dollar-bear/gold-bull scenario is a THEORY, not policy — don't own a tail as a core position.
theses.thesis_zh: 黄金在 2026 年上涨后于 4,044–4,200 区间交投，但美联储鹰派造势阶段（9 月加息概率占优、10 年期实际利率 2.29%、美元指数脱离 13 个月低点）对零息资产构成逆风，而此时美联储正在积累抗通胀信誉。Mar-a-Lago 美元走弱/黄金走强的剧本只是理论而非政策——不应把一个尾部情景当作核心持仓。
evidence: Dollar/debt theater: Mar-a-Lago labeled THEORY, tail to watch not own
Recent track: GLD underweight miss (realized +11.19% vs SPY) — gold kept rallying
theses.dissent: Geopolitical haven bid (Iran re-escalation, ceasefire collapse) can overwhelm real-rate headwinds in the short run; the prior GLD underweight call already missed to the upside.
theses.dissent_zh: 地缘政治避险买盘（伊朗再度升级、停火破裂）在短期内可能压倒实际利率的逆风；此前 GLD 看空的判断已经跑输上行方向。

falsifier.text: GLD outperforms SPY by 8% before the check-by date on further Iran escalation
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日之前，GLD 因伊朗局势进一步升级而跑赢 SPY 8%

theses.subject: XLI
theses.thesis: The defense super-cycle and re-industrialization mandates (chip tariffs, nuclear-for-AI, onshoring) flow through industrial capacity. The SCOTUS strike-down did not unwind the tariff-protection premium, and the Section 301 replacement (~12.5%) pending after July 24 preserves the onshoring bid. XLI captures the defense/capex/grid buildout without single-name nuclear risk.
theses.thesis_zh: 国防超级周期与再工业化任务（芯片关税、核能-AI、本土化）经由工业产能传导。最高法院的裁决并未解除关税保护溢价，且 7 月 24 日后待定的第 301 条替代关税（约 12.5%）维持了本土化买盘。XLI 捕捉国防/资本开支/电网建设主题，同时规避单一核能个股风险。
evidence: China theater: onshoring bid persists contingent on Section 301 handoff
Rotation targeted: Power · grid · datacenter capex
theses.dissent: If the July 24 Section 301 handoff stalls or the China truce broadens into a full tariff rollback, the protection premium unwinds and industrial margins get squeezed.
theses.dissent_zh: 若 7 月 24 日第 301 条关税过渡受阻，或中美休战扩大为全面取消关税，保护性溢价将消退，工业企业利润率受挤压。

falsifier.text: XLI lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date on Section 301 tariff rollback
falsifier.text_zh: 在检查日之前，XLI 因第 301 条关税全面取消而落后 SPY 5%
